sessions.summary: The user had the assistant view their screen, which showed the Athena interface and open drive folders.
The user greeted Athena in Arabic and requested a system shutdown using Telugu.
The user checked if Athena could hear them and requested a system status report, receiving details on CPU, RAM, battery, and uptime.
The user reconnected with the assistant and greeted her in Arabic.
Usaid Ahmed checked his system performance and inquired about why his C drive was nearly full, while also clarifying that Athena should use feminine self-referential grammar.
The user asked the assistant to switch to Urdu, requested to disable system monitoring, and inquired about the connection status of their WhatsApp bridge.
The user checked the status of their WhatsApp bridge and habit learning, enabled system monitoring, and instructed the assistant to go into standby mode to alert them of unusual system activity.
